title: 晶圓電化學銅填孔
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電化學與供電、傳質與添加劑、超共形填充、缺陷與後段；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: electrochemistry and current, transport and additives, superconformal filling, defects and downstream processing. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量
steps.titleEn: Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：實際質量還依賴電流效率。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.
steps.instruction:
用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「實際質量還依賴電流效率。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：用純粹教學電荷帳本：Cu²⁺還原為 Cu，假設 Q=0.10 C，M=63.546 g/mol，F=96485 C/mol，z=2。理想質量 m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg；若電流效率90%，則為29.64 μg。這不包含任何鍍液組成或操作條件；需再用截面體積與銅密度檢查電荷、體積及損失是否一致。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): For an educational charge ledger, reduce Cu²⁺ to Cu with Q=0.10 C, M=63.546 g/mol, F=96485 C/mol and z=2. Ideal mass m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg; at 90% current efficiency it is 29.64 μg. No bath composition or operating conditions are supplied. Check consistency against cross-sectional volume and copper density to account for charge, volume and losses.
steps.observation:
實際質量還依賴電流效率。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 32.93 與29.64 μg，不能把電流效率假設成自動100%。
steps.observationEn:
Actual mass also depends on current efficiency. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 32.93 and 29.64 μg without automatically assuming 100% efficiency.
